name: Algebraic Conjunction Masking
description: This method replaces a logical conjunction ("A AND B") with a single scalar equation involving a sum that reaches its maximum possible value ($X + Y = |X| + |Y|$). Because the variables are restricted to $\pm 1$, the equation holds if and only if both terms are independently maximized, perfectly encoding the boolean conjunction. I expect this to defeat the survivors because it completely removes the structural signature of 2-SAT (clauses, literals, boolean conditions), forcing the model to algebraically prove the equivalence before it can recognize the underlying problem class.
